name: editor-tweaks-for-codemirror
description: Tweak every CodeMirror editor in WordPress with custom themes, fonts, and display options
author: Marios Giannopoulos

scripts.i18n:make-pot: wp-env run cli -- wp i18n make-pot wp-content/plugins/editor-tweaks-for-codemirror wp-content/plugins/editor-tweaks-for-codemirror/languages/editor-tweaks-for-codemirror.pot --slug=editor-tweaks-for-codemirror --domain=editor-tweaks-for-codemirror --exclude=node_modules,vendor,.git,languages,tests
scripts.i18n:update-po: wp-env run cli -- wp i18n update-po wp-content/plugins/editor-tweaks-for-codemirror/languages/editor-tweaks-for-codemirror.pot wp-content/plugins/editor-tweaks-for-codemirror/languages/
scripts.i18n:make-mo: wp-env run cli -- wp i18n make-mo wp-content/plugins/editor-tweaks-for-codemirror/languages/
scripts.i18n: bun run i18n:make-pot && bun run i18n:update-po && bun run i18n:make-mo
scripts.bundle: mkdir -p build && bunx bestzip build/editor-tweaks-for-codemirror.zip editor-tweaks-for-codemirror.php includes/ views/ assets/ languages/ sample-data/ uninstall.php readme.txt changelog.txt LICENSE
